recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中多顆嗜伊紅系前驅細胞的細胞質布滿大而深紫色的顆粒（異常嗜伊紅球），同時混有核折疊的單核樣胚細胞，顆粒粗大深染又夾雜單核分化，是 inv(16) AML 的典型組合。
features: Mixed population of blasts and monocytoid cells with folded nuclei and moderate cytoplasm
Several eosinophil precursors with large, coarse dark purple basophilic-staining granules
Granules often admixed with orange eosinophilic granules in the same cell
Fine nuclear chromatin in blasts; some cells with visible nucleoli
Scattered small nucleated red cells/lymphocytes; granular debris from ruptured cells in background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows increased blasts and monocytoid cells with folded nuclei and fine chromatin, admixed with numerous eosinophil precursors whose cytoplasm contains large, coarse, dark purple basophilic-staining granules together with eosinophilic granules. Free granules from disrupted cells are present in the background. Mature neutrophils are few. Findings are consistent with acute myelomonocytic leukemia with abnormal eosinophils, suggestive of AML with inv(16)(p13.1q22) or t(16;16)(p13.1;q22); CBFB-MYH11.

ddx.vs: Reactive eosinophils are mature with uniform orange granules and bilobed nuclei, without increased blasts or large basophilic-staining granules.
CML shows a full granulocytic maturation spectrum with basophilia and eosinophilia and BCR-ABL1 rather than increased myelomonocytic blasts with dysplastic eosinophils.
AMML NOS lacks abnormal eosinophils and the CBFB-MYH11 fusion on cytogenetic or molecular testing.
